title: C64 Basic Dungeon Crawler: Goblin Attack (C64 Basic Part 8)
summary: A retro game development tutorial showing how to create a dungeon crawler game in Commodore 64 BASIC, specifically implementing goblin attack mechanics as part 8 of a series.
problem_solved: Teaches classic dungeon crawler game mechanics implementation on vintage Commodore 64 hardware using BASIC programming language.
why_valuable: Preserves retro programming knowledge and provides accessible entry point for learning game development fundamentals on classic 8-bit hardware.
